name: Gold-leaf glint (mythic kit)
visual_intent: A light band sweeps across gold-leaf fills (haloes, crowns, borders), the Tanjore and manuscript gold catching the lamp.

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: Film time, snapped to the spoken word (studio.py words)

timeline_requirements.gsap_instance: Timeline passed to Studio.build(builder) (registered as window.__timelines['root'])
timeline_requirements.timing_anchors: Cue map (Studio.cues) from storyboard.json or measured narration (audio/timeline.json)

code_snippet.javascript:
var M = S.kit.mythic;
var gold = M.gold(S.u(60)); /* fill: gold */ M.glint(tl, gold, at('s3', 1.8));

fallbacks: Fall back to Studio.space.pop / crossfade or a plain fromTo opacity tween if the effect reads badly in a format.
validation_steps: python scripts/frame-review.py <project> --fonts google (inspect the contact sheet)
npx hyperframes check on the render host; then hyperframes snapshot at the effect's start, middle and end

validation.evidence: Kit self-test tests/test-mythic.py (Playwright Chromium: build, seek determinism) and frame review of the mythic-film scaffold (portrait) on Windows, 2026-11-23. Not yet rendered through HyperFrames on the Apple M2 host, so not approved.
